|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E4 of [[Fleet Security Protocols]] (version 5 of 5); it is the current text. The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VB6-34-Fleet_Security_Protocols-PC-E4-master-list.png]]). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes. How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[Fleet Security Protocols]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table. During battle involving your starship (or vehicle), it is power +2 for each character at its related sites (those characters may be forfeited to reduce battle damage and attrition). Once per turn, may ▼ a non-unique starship (or vehicle) site (if such sites leave table, place them and all your cards there in Used Pile). [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata)]]): The revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (PDF dated by 20 April 2010) changed “for each character” to “for each of your characters” and “(those characters may” to “(they may”: “Deploy on table. During battle involving your starship (or vehicle), it is power +2 for each of your characters at its related sites (they may be forfeited to reduce battle damage and attrition). Once per turn, may ▼ a non-unique starship (or vehicle) site (if such sites leave table, place them and all your cards there in Used Pile). [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated by 20 April 2010), page 5, slip 34. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “34” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) rewrote the game text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may deploy a non-unique starship (or vehicle) site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle where you have a starship or vehicle, characters at related starship (or vehicle) sites cumulatively add 2 to your total power and may be forfeited to reduce battle damage or attrition. When a starship (or vehicle) site leaves table, place it and all cards there in owner's Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1261_34-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-fleetsecurityprotocols-pre.gif]]) prints the PC-E1 text of the revised 2010 sheet again, word for word: “Deploy on table. During battle involving your starship (or vehicle), it is power +2 for each of your characters at its related sites (they may be forfeited to reduce battle damage and attrition). Once per turn, may ▼ a non-unique starship (or vehicle) site (if such sites leave table, place them and all your cards there in Used Pile). [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' The card list's rewrite is gone; the image prints the words of the revised 2010 sheet (PC-E1) again. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual6-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual6-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual6-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture; it prints no slip number (the revised sheet's slip has “34”).
* '''PC-E4''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 25)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=25, page 25. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=25 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the PC-E1 text of the revised 2010 sheet again, word for word: “Deploy on table. During battle involving your starship (or vehicle), it is power +2 for each of your characters at its related sites (they may be forfeited to reduce battle damage and attrition). Once per turn, may ▼ a non-unique starship (or vehicle) site (if such sites leave table, place them and all your cards there in Used Pile). [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip shows the whole card frame with the picture area left blank; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “34”). GEMP's current card plays this text: your starship (or vehicle) in battle is power +2 for each of your characters at its related sites (instead of characters adding to your total power), and only non-unique starship (or vehicle) sites that leave table take your cards there to Used Pile (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
